Committee: Judiciary
Sponsor: Figures
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 02/08/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 196 as introduced could increase the expenditures of local boards of education and the State Department of Education by an undetermined amount dependent upon the cost to implement the changes to sex education curriculum required by this bill.
Tom Whatley, Chairperson
Judiciary
